description: This is a unit test class for the HealthService component, testing database health check functionalities using Mockito for mocking dependencies and AssertJ for assertions.

classes.name: test_HealthServiceTest
classes.description: Unit test class for testing the HealthService's database health check logic.

methods.name: checkDatabaseHealth_whenNoDataSource_returnsDown
methods.description: Tests behavior of checkDatabaseHealth method when DataSource is null, expecting a 'down' status with an error message.

methods.name: checkDatabaseHealth_whenConnectionAndProbeOk_returnsUp
methods.description: Tests behavior when database connection and query succeed, expecting an 'up' status.

methods.name: checkDatabaseHealth_whenSelectProbeFails_returnsDown
methods.description: Tests behavior when SQL query execution throws an exception, expecting a 'down' status with error details.
